system.description:
• Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • No Disadvantage against your marked prey.
  • If it drops your marked prey, you may mark a new creature you can see at once, without spending a use of Marked Prey.

activities.name: Quarry Strike
activities.text: One additional weapon attack as part of your attack action, with Disadvantage that no Advantage cancels. If it drops your marked prey, mark a new creature you can see at once, without spending a use of Marked Prey.

activities.name: Quarry Strike (against your marked prey)
activities.text: No Disadvantage on the extra attack (against your marked prey). If it drops your marked prey, mark a new creature you can see at once, without spending a use of Marked Prey.
